strings.d1.s0.name: Mykonos Chora Matoyianni
strings.d1.s0.tips: Whitewashed labyrinth lanes and bougainvillea; quiet in the morning, with boutiques.
strings.d1.s1.name: Panagia Paraportiani
strings.d1.s1.tips: A white 'snowball' church formed from five fused chapels; the island's emblem.
strings.d1.s2.name: Kato Mili Windmills
strings.d1.s2.tips: Five 16th-century windmills; views of Little Venice, best in morning light.
strings.d1.s3.name: Nikos Taverna Chora
strings.d1.s3.tips: A family taverna since the 1980s; try the lamb and moussaka, and Petros the pelican may wander past.
strings.d1.s4.name: Little Venice Sunset
strings.d1.s4.tips: Houses with balconies over the sea; have a cocktail (15 EUR) at Caprice or Scarpa, and expect spray from the waves.
strings.d1.b0.name: Kiki's Tavern Agios Sostis
strings.d1.b0.tips: A grill taverna with no electricity; expect a queue. Beside the beach (by vehicle).
strings.d1.b1.name: Aegean Maritime Museum
strings.d1.b1.tips: Combine with Lena's House; Tria Pigadia.
strings.d2.s0.name: Delos Ferry Old Port
strings.d2.s0.tips: The sacred island where Apollo was born; 30 minutes by boat (22 EUR return, 09:00/10:00); closed on Mondays.
strings.d2.s1.name: Delos Archaeological Site
strings.d2.s1.tips: A UNESCO-listed Hellenistic city; Terrace of the Lions, House of Dionysos mosaics (phallus monument), the theatre. No shade.
strings.d2.s2.name: Mount Kynthos Delos
strings.d2.s2.tips: A 113 m hill with 360° views of the Cyclades; 20 minutes.
strings.d2.s3.name: Delos Museum Cafe
strings.d2.s3.tips: The only cafe; sandwiches. Return boats at 13:30/15:00.
strings.d2.s4.name: Agios Stefanos Beach
strings.d2.s4.tips: A winter beach walk for the afternoon.
strings.d2.b0.name: Rinia Island Boat Tour
strings.d2.b0.tips: Delos's neighbour, with deserted coves; swimming, boat tour.
strings.d2.b1.name: Mykonos Old Port Cafes
strings.d2.b1.tips: Breakfast or lunch at the port, instead of the museum cafe.
strings.d3.theme: Southern beaches: Paradise and Super Paradise
strings.d3.s0.name: Platis Gialos
strings.d3.s0.tips: A family beach and the starting point for water taxis; shallow sea.
strings.d3.s1.name: Paraga Beach
strings.d3.s1.tips: A small cove with the Scorpios beach club (pricey, a sunset ritual).
strings.d3.s2.name: Paradise Beach
strings.d3.s2.tips: A 1970s hippie beach, now a party spot; Tropicana daytime party after 16:00.
strings.d3.s3.name: Super Paradise Beach
strings.d3.s3.tips: A steep cove; JackieO' beach club (LGBT-friendly) for lunch and sunbeds.
strings.d3.s4.name: Elia Beach
strings.d3.s4.tips: The island's longest quiet beach; sunbeds, and a water taxi back.
strings.d3.b0.name: Scorpios Paraga
strings.d3.b0.tips: A bohemian-luxe beach club; book ahead. A sunset ritual.
strings.d3.b1.name: Agrari Beach
strings.d3.b1.tips: Elia's quiet neighbour; reachable on foot.
strings.d4.theme: The north: Ano Mera and Fokos
strings.d4.s0.name: Panagia Tourliani Ano Mera
strings.d4.s0.tips: A monastery dating from 1542; marble bell tower, in the island's inland village, with a weekend market.
strings.d4.s1.name: Ano Mera Square Breakfast
strings.d4.s1.tips: A cafe on the village square; try loukoumades (Greek doughnuts).
strings.d4.s2.name: Fokos Beach
strings.d4.s3.name: Fokos Taverna
strings.d4.s3.tips: The beach's only taverna; home-style Greek food with Cycladic views.
strings.d4.s4.name: Panormos Beach Principote
strings.d4.s4.tips: A chic beach club (Principote) or the quiet end; the northern meltemi wind blows here.
strings.d4.b0.name: Agios Sostis Beach
strings.d4.b0.tips: Fokos's neighbour, next to Kiki's taverna.
strings.d4.b1.name: Mykonos Vioma Organic Farm
strings.d4.b1.tips: Organic vineyard and tasting; Ano Mera.
strings.d5.s0.name: Ornos Port Boat Tour
strings.d5.s0.tips: Half- or full-day sailing boat or catamaran (about 90-150 EUR, lunch included); along the south coast.
strings.d5.s1.name: Dragonisi Caves
strings.d5.s1.tips: Sea caves and Mediterranean monk seals; snorkelling.
strings.d5.s2.name: Lunch on Board
strings.d5.s3.name: Rinia Coves Swim
strings.d5.s3.tips: Turquoise coves on a deserted island; snorkelling.
strings.d5.s4.name: Ornos Beach Return
strings.d5.s4.tips: Sunbeds and cocktails at Ornos; Kuzina restaurant.
strings.d5.b0.name: Kuzina Ornos
strings.d5.b1.name: Agios Ioannis Beach
strings.d5.b1.tips: The Shirley Valentine beach; views of Delos at sunset. An alternative to Ornos.
strings.d6.s0.name: Rarity Gallery Chora
strings.d6.s1.name: Folklore Museum Mykonos
strings.d6.s1.tips: A folk museum in a captain's house; Kastro.
strings.d6.s2.name: Sakis Grill House Chora
strings.d6.s2.tips: Souvlaki and gyros; cheap and good, Kalogera.
strings.d6.s3.name: Armenistis Lighthouse
strings.d6.s3.tips: An 1891 lighthouse on the north-west cape; views of Tinos and a crowd-free sunset alternative.
strings.d6.s4.name: 180° Sunset Bar Chora
strings.d6.s4.tips: A hilltop bar with views of Chora and the sunset; book ahead.
strings.d6.b0.name: Kastro's Bar Little Venice
strings.d6.b0.tips: A sunset bar since 1976; classical music.
strings.d6.b1.name: Mykonos Brewing Company
strings.d6.b1.tips: Tasting of the island's beer; instead of the grill.
strings.d7.theme: Harbour morning and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Old Port Morning Fishermen
strings.d7.s0.tips: Petros the pelican and the fishing boats; a calm harbour.
strings.d7.s1.name: Gioras Wood Bakery
strings.d7.s1.tips: A wood-fired oven since 1420, the island's oldest; try tiropita (cheese pie) and kalathaki.
strings.d7.s2.name: Chora Streets Last Walk
strings.d7.s2.tips: Sandals (the Mykonos sandal) and kopanisti cheese as souvenirs.
strings.d7.s3.name: Mykonos Airport
strings.d7.s3.tips: 4 km from Chora by taxi or bus; farewell (the Piraeus ferry leaves from the new port).
strings.d7.b0.name: Trio Bougatsa Chora
strings.d7.b0.tips: Cretan bougatsa; instead of the bakery.
strings.d7.b1.name: Ano Mera Saturday Market
strings.note0: Buses (KTEL Fabrika and Old Port terminals) to the beaches cost 2 EUR; ATV/scooter 30-50 EUR; taxis are very scarce (expensive, no Uber). The airport is 4 km away.
strings.note1: From November to March almost everything is closed (about 10,000 locals), and it is windy at 12°C; openings in April-May; October is quiet and mild (sea 22°C).
strings.note2: Delos 12 + boat 22; taverna 20-30, beach club 60-100+, cocktail 15-20; one of Europe's most expensive islands; round your tip up.
strings.note3: Delos is closed on Mondays and has no shade, so bring water and a hat; Fokos has a dirt road (ATV); Paradise and Super Paradise parties start after 16:00.
strings.note4: Kopanisti (spicy cheese), louza (cured pork), kalathaki, the Mykonos sandal; the Gioras bakery is 600 years old.
strings.note5: Sunset: Little Venice (crowded), Armenistis (quiet), 180° bar (book ahead).
